--- file: db/migrations/0042_keep_closed_findings.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+-- Closed findings are kept for every org, even with closures off.
+ALTER TABLE closed_findings ADD COLUMN source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'collector';
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS closed_findings_key
+    ON closed_findings (org_id, finding_key);
+UPDATE closed_findings SET source = 'legacy' WHERE created_at < now();
+COMMIT;
